shutter.en: The photographer pressed the shutter just as the bird landed.
shutter.zh: 那隻鳥剛落下時，攝影師按下了快門。

shuttle.en: A free shuttle carries visitors between the station and museum.
shuttle.zh: 免費接駁車往返車站與博物館之間。

shy.en: The shy student gradually became more comfortable speaking in class.
shy.zh: 那位害羞的學生逐漸更自在地在課堂上發言。

sibling.en: Each sibling chose a different book from the library.
sibling.zh: 每位兄弟姊妹都從圖書館選了不同的書。

sick.en: He stayed home because he felt sick in the morning.
sick.zh: 他早上覺得不舒服，所以留在家裡。

sidewalk.en: The city repaired the sidewalk outside the school entrance.
sidewalk.zh: 市府修復了學校入口外的人行道。

sigh.en: She gave a quiet sigh after finishing the difficult test.
sigh.zh: 做完困難的考試後，她輕輕嘆了一口氣。

sight.en: The mountain became a beautiful sight after the clouds cleared.
sight.zh: 雲散後，那座山成為一幅美麗景象。

sightseeing.en: We spent the morning sightseeing in the old part of town.
sightseeing.zh: 我們上午在老城區觀光。

signature.en: Please add your signature at the bottom of the form.

significance.en: The teacher explained the historical significance of the discovery.
significance.zh: 老師說明這項發現的歷史意義。

silence.en: A moment of silence followed the final announcement.
silence.zh: 最後公告後，全場安靜了片刻。

silent.en: The classroom became silent when the presentation began.
silent.zh: 簡報開始時，教室變得安靜。

silk.en: The museum displayed a silk robe from the nineteenth century.
silk.zh: 博物館展示了一件十九世紀的絲質長袍。

silly.en: The silly mistake made everyone laugh during rehearsal.
silly.zh: 彩排時，那個小失誤逗得大家發笑。

silver.en: A silver medal was displayed beside the old team photograph.
silver.zh: 一面銀牌陳列在舊隊照旁。

similarity.en: The teacher asked us to identify one similarity between the two poems.
similarity.zh: 老師要我們找出兩首詩的一項相似之處。

simplicity.en: The simplicity of the design makes the website easy to use.
simplicity.zh: 簡潔的設計讓網站容易使用。

simplify.en: The diagram helps simplify a complicated scientific process.
simplify.zh: 這張圖有助於簡化複雜的科學過程。

simultaneous.en: The system recorded simultaneous changes in temperature and pressure.
simultaneous.zh: 系統記錄了溫度與壓力同時發生的變化。

sin.en: The literature class discussed the idea of sin in an old novel.
sin.zh: 文學課討論了一本舊小說中的罪惡概念。

sincere.en: She gave a sincere apology for arriving late to the meeting.
sincere.zh: 她為會議遲到真誠地道歉。

sincerity.en: His sincerity made the apology feel more meaningful.
sincerity.zh: 他的真誠讓這次道歉更有意義。

sing.en: The choir will sing two songs at the school ceremony.
sing.zh: 合唱團會在學校典禮唱兩首歌。

singer.en: The singer thanked the audience after the final song.
singer.zh: 最後一首歌結束後，歌手向觀眾致謝。

singular.en: The teacher explained when to use a singular noun in English.
singular.zh: 老師說明英文中何時使用單數名詞。

sink.en: The small boat began to sink after taking in water.

sip.en: She took a sip of water before continuing her speech.
sip.zh: 她喝了一小口水後繼續演講。

sir.en: The student politely said sir when addressing the guest speaker.
sir.zh: 學生稱呼來賓講者時禮貌地說先生。

sister.en: My sister borrowed the novel after I finished reading it.
sister.zh: 我讀完小說後，姊姊借去看了。

sit.en: Please sit near the front if you cannot see the screen.
sit.zh: 如果看不清楚螢幕，請坐到前面。

size.en: The class compared the size of several planets using a model.
size.zh: 班上用模型比較了幾顆行星的大小。

skate.en: They learned to skate at the indoor rink during winter break.
skate.zh: 寒假時，他們在室內冰場學滑冰。

skeleton.en: The biology room contains a model of the human skeleton.
skeleton.zh: 生物教室裡有一具人體骨骼模型。

sketch.en: She made a quick sketch before starting the final painting.
sketch.zh: 開始正式作畫前，她先畫了一張速寫。

ski.en: The club plans to ski during the winter training trip.
ski.zh: 社團計畫在冬季訓練旅行中滑雪。

skill.en: Reading comprehension is a skill that improves with regular practice.
skill.zh: 閱讀理解是一項會隨規律練習而進步的能力。

skilled.en: A skilled technician repaired the projector before class began.
skilled.zh: 一位熟練的技術人員在上課前修好投影機。

skillful.en: Her skillful explanation made the difficult idea easier to understand.
skillful.zh: 她熟練的解說讓困難的概念更容易理解。

skim.en: Skim the article first to understand its main idea.
skim.zh: 先快速瀏覽文章以了解主要概念。

skip.en: Do not skip the instructions at the top of the page.
skip.zh: 不要略過頁面頂端的說明。

skirt.en: The costume included a long skirt for the stage performance.
skirt.zh: 舞台表演的服裝包含一件長裙。

sky.en: The evening sky turned orange just before sunset.
sky.zh: 日落前，傍晚天空變成橘色。

skyscraper.en: The new skyscraper can be seen from across the river.
skyscraper.zh: 隔著河就能看見那棟新的摩天大樓。

slang.en: The teacher explained that slang is common in casual conversation.
slang.zh: 老師說明俚語在日常對話中很常見。

sleepy.en: He felt sleepy after staying up late to finish homework.
sleepy.zh: 他熬夜完成作業後覺得很想睡。

sleeve.en: A small patch was sewn onto the jacket sleeve.
sleeve.zh: 外套袖子上縫了一個小布章。

slice.en: She placed a slice of apple beside the sandwich.
slice.zh: 她在三明治旁放了一片蘋果。

slide.en: The final slide summarizes the main points of the presentation.
slide.zh: 最後一張投影片整理了簡報重點。

slight.en: There was a slight improvement in the second test score.
slight.zh: 第二次測驗的成績有些微進步。
